arjun: Noticed a small class of tenants where the invoice preview intermittently overshoots the final ledger by ~0.8-1.5%. Triggered when route-priority window=15m in the preview toggle.

nina: Which tenants? any commonality (streaming, short sessions)?

arjun: Mostly APAC streaming and a couple of EU analytics tenants. Pretty consistent pattern: preview > ledger.

carla: Upload a couple sample traces? suspect fallback_reason rewrite plus dedupe key variance between preview and finalize.

arjun: pasted samples:
```
preview_config: {priority_window:15m, enrich:shadow-v1, dedupe_key: [session_id, client_fingerprint] }
ledger_config: {watermark:3m, enrich:main-v2, dedupe_key: [session_id, client_fingerprint, route_tag_v2]}
preview_row_count=987,321
ledger_row_count=974,451
delta=+12,870
```

tom: aha. ledger includes route_tag_v2 in key; preview doesn't because shadow-v1 didn't yet add route_tag_v2. If fallback rewrites route_tag we get different deduping.

nina: This is subtle: console preview toggle only mutates the shadow enrich config. It doesn't simulate route rewrite behavior applied later by the router. So previews look wrong for tenants affected by route rewriting.

ui-bot: note: current Preview UI copy says "Matches billing behavior" which is now inaccurate for some cases.

carla: We should avoid changing dedupe key mid-rollout but that ship sailed for enrich-v2 canary yesterday. Options: (A) change preview to run enrich-v2 when toggle enabled; (B) surface explicit "routing rewrite differs" disclaimer in UI; (C) add preview metadata that tags preview rows with enrich_version and route_rewrite_version for auditing.

arjun: I prefer C + B. Low blast risk and gives traceability.

tom: Adding enrich_version to preview rows is cheap. Exposing route_rewrite_version is trickier because router uses dynamic rules. Could add a best-effort header at ingest time.

billing-bot: scheduled small reconcile job `mini-recon-174555` for affected tenants, ETA 30m. Will attach job id.

nina: Also propose a lightweight metric: preview_inconsistent:deltas_over_0.5pct tagged by tenant_region to alert rollout anomalies.

carla: API debate: should /internal/metering/preview-toggle apply a "simulate rewrites" flag that asks the router to emit a rewrite snapshot? That couples router with preview code path. Pros: more accurate previews. Cons: exposes router state and increases risk for preview runs (router hotpath).

arjun: I'm against coupling critical router logic to preview unless behind a canary gate. We need safe defaults.

ui-bot: UX ask from support: show "why preview might differ" modal linking to a short checklist: dedupe_key changes, rewrite rules, late-arrivals, watermark mismatch.

carla: Action items:
- tom: add enrich_version tag to preview rows and instrumentation (ETA 3h)
- arjun: run `mini-recon-174555` and post CSV (ETA 45m)
- nina: add preview_inconsistent metric + dashboard panel (ETA EOD)
- ui-bot (ux): update modal copy and remove "Matches billing behavior" claim (ETA tomorrow)

arjun: will post results from the reconcile job here. thanks team.

billing-bot: reconcile job `mini-recon-174555` started at 1745550200. will update on completion.

arjun: follow-up: reconcile found 9k tokens of unaccounted duplication linked to route_tag rewrite mismatches. I'll open a PR with sample rows and include a short explanation for the billing team.

nina: good. once PR lands let's flip the UI copy and wire the metric so we can catch regressions earlier.

carla: tagging @billing-team in the PR for awareness.

arjun: closing thread; will keep audit trail in the PR and link the reconcile artifact here.
